requirements:
Many different airlines can operate in different airports. 
An airline has a name and an airport has a code and is in a city.
Each airline has associated a cost for operating in a specific airport. 
Besides, the operation of an airline in a specific airport can be started and stopped at any time, and its operating cost can be updated at any time.
The relation between airport and airline contains a details class with the operating cost.

issues.message: The Details class should be associated with the Airline_Airport_Relation class through a composite relationship, not a one-to-many.
issues.evidence: Each airline has associated a cost for operating in a specific airport. Besides, the operation of an airline in a specific airport can be started and stopped at any time, and its operating cost can be updated at any time.
suggestions: Change the relationship type between Details and Airline_Airport_Relation to composite (e.g., `Details --* Airline_Airport_Relation`)
